name: Supremacism
summary: Supremacism holds that one group is superior to all others and should have authority over them, on grounds such as race, religion or nation. In its best-documented modern form, white supremacism, it ranks races by innate capacity, opposes equality and race mixing, seeks restricted immigration and segregated or racially defined states, and has justified slavery, colonialism and genocide.
scope: Supremacism is the belief that one group of people is inherently superior to others and should have authority over them (Merriam-Webster, s3; Dictionary.com, s4). The group can be defined by race, ethnicity, sex, gender or religion (s3). The defining sources that discuss it at length (Britannica, the International Encyclopedia of the Social Sciences, the SPLC: s1, s2, s6-s9) treat it almost entirely as white supremacy: the Aryan racial hierarchy, the Klan, Jim Crow law, apartheid, the Nazi state, Christian Identity. This profile therefore represents racial supremacism in its white form (Gobineau, the Aryanists, the Klan and Jim Crow, Nazi racial doctrine, the modern white supremacist movement) as the sources document it. It excludes supremacisms for which they give no positions (male, religious, Han, Hutu, Black), and it does not borrow the sources of the separate catalog entries White supremacy, Black supremacy and Jewish supremacy.
